scope: Recurring lasting-feed evaluation and adapter layout checks only: parser and extraction results, not generation quality. Full fetched HTML stays outside Git and public paths. Samples are structure-only skeletons of inspected pages: real tags and class names, synthetic prose, and sentinel text in every module that must be excluded.

feeds.format: RSS 2.0, dated pubDate, description blurbs only
feeds.note: Sight and Sound reviews, features, interviews and lists, plus some BFI news. One EmbeddedArticleText__TextContent root on every item page.

feeds.format: RSS 2.0, dated pubDate, description blurbs only
feeds.note: Classics essays, roughly three to five a month; a few competition notices and reader features.

feeds.reason: Article pages serve a Cloudflare "Just a moment..." challenge to automated requests. Bot checks are never bypassed.
The feed returns HTTP 403 to automated requests.
The feed returns HTTP 403 to automated requests.
Full content:encoded prose, but art and archival curiosities fit none of the fixed reader topics.
Mostly new-release, streaming and festival reviews: timely criticism, not lasting reading.
